status: planned — NOT built; milestone-2 buildable recipe for the approved contract. null = a pin that genuinely requires the lock phase, never a silent default
revision_note: immutable source revision is pinned by the lock phase at build time
tokenizer_rev_note: immutable tokenizer revision, asset digest, and implementation version are pinned by the lock phase
hash_seed_note: per-corpus seed derived by the lock phase from the recipe and locked source state; the legacy 'colonnade-165' pin is never reused
exclude_note: the standalone sample/10BT, sample/100BT, sample/350BT subsets (real upstream paths) overlap the per-crawl shards and are excluded; selection is anchored and segment-aware, so nested lookalikes never match
upstream_filtering: preserved — the published FineWeb-Edu educational-score filtering is taken as-is

dedup_policy.cross_crawl: retain cross-crawl duplicates — NO global dedup
dedup_policy.dev_repetition_filter: NOT applied (the legacy dev-only repetition filter is dropped)

transforms_note: upstream-only: FineWeb-Edu enables NO pithos transforms — no global dedup, no legacy repetition filter (and neither exists in the transform registry)

validation_reservation.method: domain-separated keyed hash of the document key

ordering: global ascending keyed BLAKE2b-128 over (crawl, document_id); the key order IS the uniform global shuffle
encoding: [BOS] + tokens + [EOS] per document; documents whose tokenization contains the EOS id are dropped (counted, bounded by max_eos_drop_rate)
publish_root_note: immutable publish destination is pinned by the lock phase at build time

full.description: full per-crawl FineWeb-Edu train stream under the approved contract (cross-crawl duplicates retained)

validation.description: the reserved 0.1% validation split, published as its own manifest

variants_note: the standalone sample/350BT reproduction and the legacy flat-token-stream re-chunk are SEPARATE recipes/builds (fineweb_edu_sample_350bt_pithos_v1.json, legacy_fineweb_edu_rechunk_v1.json) — never key-order prefixes of this corpus
identity: no identity until built: a built corpus is identified by its manifest.json canonical sha256, verified at read time
